name: What is the process for scheduling a residential repair with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for scheduling a residential repair with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for scheduling a residential repair with Maine Results, Inc. typically starts with an initial contact via phone or our website to describe your repair needs. Next, we arrange an on-site visit to your home in our service areas like Meridian or Boise Heights for a detailed assessment and to provide an estimate. Once the estimate is approved, we schedule the repair work at a mutually convenient time. Clear communication during each step helps ensure a smooth and efficient repair process for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule by contacting us, followed by an on-site assessment, estimate approval, and then scheduling the repair work.
